title: Uruguayan Frittata
description: A traditional Uruguayan-inspired omelette with gouda cheese, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add shredded gouda cheese and mix well.
Heat a 9-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour in egg mixture and cook until edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle crumbled Uruguayan cheese on top (if using).
Transfer skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the eggs are almost set.
Remove from oven and sprinkle grated cheese on top (if using).
Let it rest for 1-2 minutes before slicing and serving.
